contract: Reuse accepted 88 static and 36 agent-generated definitions; plugin identities are open-ended, syntax-validated and at most 400 characters. Non-darwin/non-win32 platform maps to linux catalog.
remainingAcceptance: For every accepted static/agent row verify selected-platform defaults; reject malformed plugin ids and preserve valid uninstalled plugin overrides without inventing finite plugin total.

contract: Legacy GlobalSettings.keybindings getter is called at every service construction, before migrateLegacyKeybindings checks file existence. Existing file wins; absent file plus nonempty legacy input writes active-platform section.
remainingAcceptance: Run original migration tests unchanged; add startup integration test proving legacy getter wiring, existing-file precedence and repeated construction without re-migration.

contract: Read supports legacy root-level and common keybindings sections, then active-platform override; null/false in file means disabled empty list. Invalid values produce diagnostics; malformed unreadable file is preserved on attempted write.
remainingAcceptance: Verify common/platform precedence, null/false/empty disable, unknown keys, bad values, diagnostics and unreadable-file preservation using real temporary files.

contract: Settings writes only active-platform section; API null removes mask and exposes common value, while [] disables action. Normalize and reject conflicts; preserve unrelated platforms and document keys.
remainingAcceptance: Preserve reset-only-active-platform test, distinguish file-null from API-null, test empty array disable and foreign-platform survival.

contract: Dedicated keybinding writer uses writeFileSync to .tmp then renameSync and cleanup-on-error; it does not call durable-file-write or fsync. SP13 low-level passing receipt cannot prove keybinding-file crash durability.
remainingAcceptance: Record source baseline for write/rename errors and preserved original document; if rewrite strengthens durability, test it explicitly without attributing that guarantee to source.

contract: Normalization rejects Mod combined with meta/control, requires modifiers except explicit safe-bare/shift-only permissions and Shift+Insert, canonicalizes double taps and digit-index chords, and deduplicates lists.
remainingAcceptance: Port normalization/action-permission cases unchanged; verify unsafe bare letters rejected, allowed F/navigation keys, shift-only input-source row and representative digits 1-9.

contract: Mod means meta on darwin and control elsewhere; exact modifier equality. Logical letters/digits/punctuation win; physical fallback is restricted to dead/unidentified, non-Latin primary-modifier and macOS Option-composed cases; protect AltGr text input.
remainingAcceptance: Run layout suite plus actual macOS/Windows/Linux keyboard events: non-QWERTY logical remaps, Cyrillic/Greek, AltGr, JIS brackets, Option-composed keys and numpad zoom.

contract: Terminal context defaults orca-first; terminal-first allows terminal scope or allowInTerminal. Empty overrides disable defaults and invalid override strings are filtered; matching requires known static/dynamic core definition.
remainingAcceptance: Compare both policies across terminal/global/editor/menu scopes and explicit overrides, including scope-only metadata versus actual handler return value.

contract: Conflict identity expands platform modifiers and digit-index family, partitions by conflictGroup and scope, and reports collisions involving customized/relevant actions. Parser may discard conflicting custom overrides over bounded iterations.
remainingAcceptance: Port conflict tests; verify two-scope/menu overlap, 1-9 collisions, ignored disabled agents and plugin default collisions marked relevant in catalog.

contract: Only enabled agent rows with nonempty user override are dispatch candidates; default new-agent-tab resolves detected/enabled preferred agent then auto-pick. Blank workspace default does not mean explicit new-agent chord must do nothing.
remainingAcceptance: Port agent-tab shortcut tests; verify disabled binding becomes inert and re-enable restores it, detected-agent fallback and no eligible installed agent.

contract: Plugin commands become runtime definitions; worktree-context command requires active worktree, first matching eligible command wins. Global app listener gives plugins precedence only in app focus; terminal/editor/browser retain authority.
remainingAcceptance: Test dynamic plugin install/disable/consent changes, worktree absence, user overrides and collisions under app/editor/terminal/browser focus using real plugin registry where required.

contract: Renderer reads committed state through layout-effect ref; skips prevented events, active recorder and repeat; preserves editable/floating-terminal ownership, special search selection and empty floating close behavior. Double tap resets on blur.
remainingAcceptance: Test recorder suppression, editable bold, floating empty close/maximize, selected explorer folder search, plugin precedence, repeat/blur and stale-state updates without listener remount.

contract: Main before-input routes explicit allowlist for guest focus; recorder yields, dev F12 special-case, mac paste ownership, recent-tab held interaction yields keyup, Markdown bold yields. Dictation consumes only enabled/model-selected toggle mode, hold mode stays renderer-owned.
remainingAcceptance: Port main-window/guest shortcut tests and real Electron focus transitions; confirm no double dispatch, repeat behavior, modifier release commit, browser guest forwarding, hold dictation keyup and native zoom respects unbinding.

contract: Mission Control digit hotkeys 118-126 require enabled standard 3-parameter entries and supported masks; physical keycodes resolve through current layout before conflict display. This is dynamic OS data, not static catalog metadata.
remainingAcceptance: Port symbolic-hotkey/layout tests; on macOS probe actual user layout/hotkeys read-only and verify warnings without changing preferences or treating an empty probe as no OS conflict.

contract: Auto Option-as-Alt subscribes to layout probe; US fingerprint enables Alt, non-US/unknown preserves composition, and explicit true/false/left/right wins. JIS Yen mapping is a separate setting.
remainingAcceptance: Port probe/detection/input-source tests and actual layout switching; verify unknown API fallback, mid-session re-probe, sided Option keys and JIS input/composition.

contract: Service snapshot is cached until explicit reload or service mutation; existing invalid file still prevents legacy migration. IPC change broadcasts rebuild native menu, while direct disk edits are not automatically observed by these service methods alone.
remainingAcceptance: Test cached snapshot versus external disk edit then explicit reload, invalid existing file with valid legacy input, cross-window keybindings:changed publication and native menu update.
